description: tests/test_pretty.py pins the Rich human-facing renderers in tether/pretty.py: the two-line status header (the 'Tether Count' line and the per-state breakdown, nonzero counts in state color and zero counts dimmed), the severity-ordered attention table (per-state colors for the State badge and the a/b artifact cells, gray tether ids, rename candidates), the --no-color path dropping state SGR codes, the refs view (the 'Key:' legend rendered in the full state color matching the panel borders, panel border tinted by aggregate state, queried path underlined), the neutral show catalog (no state color), and the single-tether diff and BROKEN rename-candidate panels. Changes to pretty.py's output structure, function signatures, or state presentation must be reflected in these assertions.
